_readme: In-store specials. These only appear on the /in-store-specials/ page (top 3 also on the home page) and are written to be redeemed at the showroom. Fields: value = the big number/phrase in the card header (keep it to 2 or 3 words, e.g. 'Save $7,300', 'From $26,295', 'Free'); badge = small label; details = up to 3 short lines; claimCode = shown at the counter (null = no code needed); endsOn = YYYY-MM-DD or null; locations = ['all'] or store ids. Set active:false to hide.
pageIntro: These offers are only available when you visit the showroom. Show the claim code on your phone at the counter, or mention it when you call ahead.

specials.title: Jacuzzi J-400 Floor Model Clearance
specials.summary: Showroom floor models from the 2025 J-400 series, fully inspected and covered by the full Jacuzzi warranty. Limited to what each showroom has on the floor.

specials.title: Try Before You Buy: Book a Wet Test
specials.summary: Bring your swimsuit and try the seats, jets and lounger before you decide. We fill and heat a tub for you, no pressure and no charge.
